_about: Public-domain George Barrell Cheever (1807-1890), Presbyterian and Congregational minister of New York's Church of the Puritans and abolitionist, for the Word Hoard: The Hierarchical Despotism (1844), Lectures on the Pilgrim's Progress (1846), A Defence of Capital Punishment (1846), Wanderings of a Pilgrim in the Shadow of Mont Blanc (1848), The Hill Difficulty (1849), Voices of Nature (1852), Deacon Giles's Distillery and other miscellanies (1853), The Powers of the World to Come (1853), Right of the Bible in our Public Schools (1854), Windings of the River of the Water of Life (1855), Lectures on Cowper (1856), God against Slavery (1857) and The Guilt of Slavery and the Crime of Slaveholding (1860). from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 60 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
